meta.description: All context strings used in the Trelis protocol for BLAKE3 derive_key domain separation

notes.purpose: Context strings provide domain separation for key derivation. Each context string MUST be unique for its use case and MUST NOT change after protocol deployment.
notes.usage: Used with BLAKE3 derive_key(context, input) to derive keys
notes.test_input: 32 zero bytes used as input for reference output computation

vectors.name: hybrid_kem_context
vectors.description: Context for hybrid KEM shared secret combination (X448 + sntrup761)
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-hybrid/src/combiner.rs for combining X448 and sntrup761 shared secrets

vectors.name: session_context
vectors.description: Context for X3DH-PQ session key derivation from transcript
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/transcript.rs for deriving session shared secret

vectors.name: pq_ratchet_root_context
vectors.description: Context for double ratchet root key derivation
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/kdf.rs (KDF_ROOT) for deriving new root keys during ratchet step

vectors.name: pq_ratchet_message_context
vectors.description: Context for double ratchet message key derivation
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/kdf.rs (KDF_MESSAGE) for deriving message encryption keys

vectors.name: ratchet_nonce_context
vectors.description: Context for hedged nonce derivation in double ratchet
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/nonce.rs (NONCE_CONTEXT) for hedged nonce generation

vectors.name: safety_number_context
vectors.description: Context for safety number fingerprint derivation
vectors.usage: Used for deriving safety number fingerprints for identity verification

vectors.name: sig_prekey_bundle_context
vectors.description: Context for pre-key bundle signature prehash
vectors.usage: Used for prehashing pre-key bundle data before signing

vectors.name: bundle_wrap_context
vectors.description: Context for device key wrap encryption
vectors.usage: Used for wrapping device keys during key distribution

vectors.name: root_key_context
vectors.description: Context for deriving initial root key from X3DH-PQ shared secret
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/session_keys.rs (ROOT_KEY_CONTEXT) for session key derivation

vectors.name: send_chain_context
vectors.description: Context for deriving initial send chain key
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/session_keys.rs (SEND_CHAIN_CONTEXT) for session key derivation

vectors.name: recv_chain_context
vectors.description: Context for deriving initial receive chain key
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/session_keys.rs (RECV_CHAIN_CONTEXT) for session key derivation

vectors.name: ratchet_init_context
vectors.description: Context for initialising double ratchet from session key
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/kdf.rs (derive_initial_root_key) for ratchet initialisation

vectors.name: device_revocation_context
vectors.description: Context for device revocation certificate signing
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-multidevice/src/revocation.rs (REVOCATION_CONTEXT) for device revocation

vectors.name: history_key_share_context
vectors.description: Context for history key sharing between devices
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-multidevice/src/history.rs (HISTORY_KEY_SHARE_CONTEXT) for sharing history access

vectors.name: prekey_bundle_domain
vectors.description: Domain separation prefix for pre-key bundle signing (used as bytes, not derive_key)
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/bundle.rs (BUNDLE_DOMAIN) as prefix for bundle signing data

vectors.name: hybrid_kem_v2_context
vectors.description: Context for the v2 hybrid KEM combiner (binds the full encapsulation: ct_sntrup, x448_eph, pk_hybrid). CMB-01 / v1.5 F02.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-hybrid/src/combiner.rs (HYBRID_KEM_V2_CONTEXT) for combine_v2. v1 (trelis-hybrid-kem-v1) is retained alongside.

vectors.name: sig_bop2_h1_context
vectors.description: Context for the Bird-of-Prey-2 hybrid signature H1: m' = derive_key(ctx, pkID || pkSig || message || R). CMB-02 / v1.5 F03.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-hybrid/src/signature.rs (SIG_BOP2_H1_CONTEXT) to bind the full hybrid vk and commitment into the ML-DSA message

vectors.name: sig_bop2_h2_context
vectors.description: Context for the Bird-of-Prey-2 hybrid signature H2: the Ed448 Schnorr challenge chl = H2(sigma2) (114-byte BLAKE3 XOF). CMB-02 / v1.5 F03.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-hybrid/src/signature.rs (SIG_BOP2_H2_CONTEXT) to derive the Ed448 challenge from the ML-DSA-65 signature (via a 114-byte XOF, not derive_key's 32-byte output)

vectors.name: session_context_v2
vectors.description: Context for the v2 X3DH-PQ session key derivation from the 299-byte transcript that binds the additive {version || suite-id || SessionFlags} framing block. TXB-01 / v1.5 F08 + F18.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/transcript.rs (SESSION_V2_CONTEXT) for deriving the session shared secret from the 299-byte version/suite/SessionFlags-bound transcript. v1 (trelis-session-v1) is retained alongside.

vectors.name: cocoa_welcome_sign_context
vectors.description: Context for the CoCoA-SA Welcome committer signature (GAP-01 / Insider-A). The group creator (create_group) or adder (add.rs::create_welcome_message) signs group_id || epoch || leaf_position || tree_depth || member_count || len(encapsulation) || encapsulation || len(encrypted_info) || encrypted_info under this context (WR-05: the two variable-length fields are u32-LE length-prefixed so the signature commits their boundary; the signed body is internal and re-derived on both sign and verify sides, so this does not change the on-wire Welcome format); process_welcome verifies it against the caller-supplied committer identity BEFORE join_group.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-cocoa/src/operations/init.rs (WELCOME_SIGN_CONTEXT) with sign_with_context/verify_with_context (used as bytes, not derive_key). The derive_key KAT over 32 zero bytes pins the string, matching the other byte-used context entries (e.g. prekey_bundle_domain). A distinct context from cocoa-sa-commit-sign-v1.

vectors.name: aead_commit_context
vectors.description: Context for the committing-AEAD key commitment (Encrypt-then-BLAKE3-commit, CMT-4). K_commit = derive_key(AEAD_COMMIT_CONTEXT, K) keys the 32-byte BLAKE3 commitment appended to XChaCha20-Poly1305 by the multi-key wraps. AEAD-01 / v1.5 F01.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-primitives/src/blake3_kdf.rs (AEAD_COMMIT_CONTEXT) and aead.rs (encrypt_committing/decrypt_committing) to key the appended BLAKE3 key-commitment. Applied by the multi-key wraps: trelis-cocoa seed_encrypt + init Welcome (54-02) and trelis-multidevice device_key_wrap (54-03).

vectors.name: sig_bop2_h1_ctx_context
vectors.description: Context for the Bird-of-Prey-2 hybrid signature H1 on the explicit-context signing path (sign_with_context / verify_with_context). Domain-separates the context path from the plain sign() path at the m' root (WR-03): m' = derive_key(ctx, pkID || pkSig || (ctx_len || context || message) || R). Sibling of sig_bop2_h1_context.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-hybrid/src/signature.rs (SIG_BOP2_H1_CTX_CONTEXT via H1Domain::Context) to derive m' on the explicit-context signing path. The base sig_bop2_h1_context (plain path) is unchanged.

vectors.name: sig_bop2_h1_prehash_context
vectors.description: Context for the Bird-of-Prey-2 hybrid signature H1 on the BLAKE3-prehash signing path (sign_prehashed / verify_prehashed). Domain-separates the prehash path from the plain sign() path at the m' root (WR-03): m' = derive_key(ctx, pkID || pkSig || derive_key(context, message) || R). Sibling of sig_bop2_h1_context.
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-hybrid/src/signature.rs (SIG_BOP2_H1_PREHASH_CONTEXT via H1Domain::Prehashed) to derive m' on the prehash signing path. The base sig_bop2_h1_context (plain path) is unchanged.
